_meta.title: Checkpoint release manifest: Cumulative-Goodness Free-Riding in Forward-Forward Networks: Real, Repairable, but Not Accuracy-Dominant (NeurIPS 2026)
_meta.release_policy: Public release: the 85 files with availability 'public_hf' (subset 'public') are on the Hugging Face repository. They are stage1_best.pt and stage2_best.pt of the CIFAR-100 trio and MGC arms (seeds 42/123/456), the CIFAR-10 squared-hinge (both arms), MGC-D128 and CP-FAIR runs (all seeds), the Tiny ImageNet gamma=0 runs (seeds 42/123/456) and the CIFAR-10 NoMem-L2 run (seed 42); the best.pt of the nine CIFAR-10 BP runs behind the BP rows of Table 2 (group bp_calibration); and stage1_best.pt and stage2_best.pt of the nine text-domain runs of App. K (group text_domain). Release history: the 4 seed-42 CIFAR-100 Stage-1 files (uploaded 2026-09-25, subset 'minimal'); 25 further Stage-1 files (2026-10-24); the Stage-2 files of these 29 runs and the bp_calibration and text_domain groups (2026-10-26). The other 48 files listed here ('on_request': stage1_best.pt and stage2_best.pt of the 24 CIFAR-10 gamma=0, gated-ablation and hardness-gated kappa=0 runs) are available from the author on request (amir.usefi75@gmail.com); their SHA-256 below lets the recipient verify them.

availability_values.public_hf: uploaded to the Hugging Face repository at hf_path (license CC BY 4.0)
availability_values.on_request: not on the Hub; available from the author on request. hf_path is the path that release/stage_release.py --subset full gives the file when it is staged for sharing

minimal.description: the first public Hugging Face release (uploaded 2026-09-25): seed-42 stage1_best of the CIFAR-100 gamma=0, gated kappa=0, cumulative gamma=0.7 and MGC arms (main-text Table 3); all four are also in the public subset

full.description: every checkpoint file listed in this manifest: 133 files of 71 runs in 14 groups (the 85 public files plus the 48 available on request)

public.description: the public Hugging Face release: every file with availability 'public_hf' (since 2026-10-26)

_meta.hashing: SHA-256 over the full file bytes (Python hashlib, 8 MiB chunks). Archive members were streamed from the Google Drive export zips without extraction; zipfile verified each member's CRC-32 (for tar_member sources: the CRC-32 of the enclosing .tar.gz). Extracted copies were cross-checked against their archive member's CRC-32.
_meta.source_paths: relative to FF_HOME (the root that contains amir-porjects/ and ff-next/); 'archive.zip::member' means a member of that zip file; 'archive.zip::run.tar.gz::member' means a member of a .tar.gz that is itself a member of that zip file
_meta.files_per_run: FF runs (every group except bp_calibration and text_domain): stage1_best.pt (validation-selected Stage-1 network incl. EMA weights; S1/S1-TTA numbers) and stage2_best.pt (the same Stage-1 network plus the Stage-2 head; S2/S2-TTA numbers; its epoch_stage1 is the run's last Stage-1 epoch, not the selected one). bp_calibration: the run's checkpoints/best.pt (the validation-selected BP network), published as <run>_best.pt. text_domain: stage1_best.pt (validation-selected FF network, raw and EMA weights) and stage2_best.pt (the Stage-2 head only; it runs on the stage1_best.pt EMA network), published as <run>_stage1_best.pt and <run>_stage2_best.pt. *_last.pt resume files are not part of the release.
_meta.resumed_runs_note: None of these trainers saved RNG state in checkpoints, so a resumed run is not a bitwise continuation of an uninterrupted run; the camera-ready trainers save and restore it.
lineage_notes: MGC-D128 seed 42 comes from the local DGX Spark (GB10) run (mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints); seeds 123/456 from Colab.

Squared-hinge seed 42 (both arms) comes from the Colab run in mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints_from_drive. The mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints/ff_cifar10_hinge_*seed42* files are from aborted DGX runs (no final evaluation) and are NOT released.

CIFAR-100 trio: stage1_best from the extracted copies in ff-next/checkpoints/trio (CRC-32 equal to the archive members), stage2_best streamed from ff_cifar100_multiseed-20260425T214118Z-3-00{1..7}.zip.

Tiny ImageNet gamma=0: stage1_best and stage2_best are streamed from the ff_tiny_imagenet_multiseed Drive export zips (tiny_imagenet_fair/from_drive_2); the final run directory of each seed names both files in its final test evaluation.
CIFAR-10 NoMem-L2 seed 42: the original run in basic_fair_revised_valfix_do_this_first (one run directory, Stage-1 epochs 1-362, 300 Stage-2 epochs).

bp_calibration: each file is the run's checkpoints/best.pt (seed 42 from making_v1_v4_fair_comparison/ablations, the submitted runs; seeds 123/456 from mgc_rebuttal/bp_anchors, the rebuttal runs); the run's final_metrics.json names it and its test top-1 is the value behind Table 2.

text_domain: stage1_best.pt and stage2_best.pt are streamed from the per-run tarballs (archives/<run>.tar.gz) inside the CP_FAIR_TEXT Drive export zips (text_domain/CP_FAIR_TEXT-20260415T151629Z-3-00{1,2,3}.zip); each tarball holds one run directory, with config.json, final_metrics.json and the Stage-1/Stage-2 histories.
not_released: CIFAR-10 gamma=0 L4/D256 seed 42 (the published run): checkpoint not recoverable. The other CIFAR-10 gamma=0 L4/D256 seed-42 checkpoints come from different runs, the component ablation (tab:component_ablation) and the seed-42 rerun in the seed-123/456 configuration (tab:gamma0_multiseed), which this manifest does not list.
CIFAR-100 32-expert MoE gamma=0.7 baseline (tab:cifar100_multiseed): checkpoints of all three seeds kept, but not listed or released.

_meta.not_covered: This manifest lists the checkpoints of 71 of the paper's runs. It does not list the checkpoints of the paper's other runs, for example the single-seed CIFAR-10 variants of tab:main_results and tab:full_main_results other than NoMem-L2 (such as BASELINE, MULTI-TECH, GREEDY-FREEZE, CP-FAIR-LC and DP-FAIR), the component ablation (tab:component_ablation), arms (a)-(c) of the MGC control (tab:f1_control), the CIFAR-10 gamma=0 seed-42 rerun (tab:gamma0_multiseed) and the three seeds of the CIFAR-100 32-expert gamma=0.7 baseline (tab:cifar100_multiseed), and the FF rows of tab:bp_ff_ablation (Table 2) on the plain CNN (3 seeds) and on the stripped backbone (seed 42).
